task_completion.description: The agent opens the protein gel image in Fiji/ImageJ.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A window titled 'protein_gel.tif' or similar is visible within the Fiji/ImageJ interface showing a grayscale gel image.

task_completion.description: The agent defines lanes and generates intensity profile plots.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Rectangular selections over the gel lanes and a 'Plot Lanes' window showing peaks corresponding to band intensities.

task_completion.description: The agent performs background subtraction (e.g., drawing baseline) and integrates peak areas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Wand' tool being used to click inside peaks in the profile plot, or a 'Results' table appearing with 'Area' or 'Mean' values.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the lane intensity profile plots to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer window or terminal command showing 'lane_profiles.png' saved in ~/Fiji_Data/results/gel/.

task_completion.description: The agent saves the quantification data (raw, normalized, background, peak area %) to a CSV file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A CSV file named 'band_quantification.csv' is visible in the file system or opened in a text editor showing columns for lane ID and normalized intensity.

task_completion.description: The agent generates a text report identifying highest/lowest expression and listing normalized values.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text file 'densitometry_report.txt' is displayed containing a summary of the findings, specifically identifying the highest and lowest lanes relative to Lane 1.

integrity.description: The agent used the Fiji/ImageJ GUI tools for densitometry rather than just writing a script to generate dummy data.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the Fiji toolbar, ROI manager, or profile plot windows being actively manipulated.

integrity.description: The normalized values in the report match the data derived from the gel image.
integrity.visual_evidence: The values in the CSV/Report correspond to the relative peak heights seen in the profile plots.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the final report content without performing the analysis steps.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows a logical progression from image opening to plotting to data extraction.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The source image is an 8-bit grayscale gel (originally gel.gif from ImageJ samples). Lane 1 is the reference (loading control), so its normalized intensity must be 1.0. The analysis must be performed using Fiji/ImageJ's 'Gels' analyzer or similar ROI-based densitometry. The final output must include a CSV with specific columns (lane ID, raw intensity, normalized intensity, background intensity, peak area %) and a PNG of the profile plots.
